notes: Human Foods Program letter for a Commerce, CA RTE-food packaging facility; violations are 21 CFR 117 preventive-controls failures (undeclared-allergen hazard, no environmental monitoring/handwashing procedures) and food misbranding (undeclared allergens, missing label elements) for two named products. 21 CFR 117 is a food preventive-controls rule, not one of the drug/device CGMP parts (210/211/111/820), so 'CGMP' is not applied here; no adulteration charge is made, only misbranding.
